title: Change list for one document
description: Every change to make in one document (a text file, a Word document, a CSV file or one JSON Lines record) to anonymize it. The file holds the original excerpts and is therefore personal data. It stays in the project folder.

document_id.description: The document ID: the path under raw/ (for example interview-01.docx), and for JSON Lines the path plus /<record ID>.

policy_version.description: policy_version from the policy.json the list was made under.

model.description: The model or deployment that made the list.

passes.description: How many times the document has been gone through: 1 after the first pass, 2 after the re-read, and so on.

position.description: Where in the document: line number in .txt and .md, paragraph number in .docx, row number without the header row in .csv, null in .jsonl. segments.py shows it.

field.description: content for text files and Word, the column name in .csv, the path to the value in .jsonl (for example messages[3].content).

original.description: Verbatim excerpt of the segment to change. Must be found exactly like this.

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of original in the segment the change applies to, from 1. With several occurrences, make one change per occurrence.

action.description: replace = swap for a placeholder, generalize = swap for a more general description, remove = remove and mark.

replacement.description: The text to insert. Placeholders in square brackets, for example [PERSON_1] or [removed: identifying detail].

category.description: What kind of identifier the text is.

reason.description: A short reason, for example why the combination identifies someone in this population.

round.description: The pass that found the change: 1 = first pass (default), 2 = re-read.

residual_risk.description: The assessed risk of identification after the changes, given the population and recipients in policy.json.

needs_review.description: Uncertain cases for a human to decide. Taken out of the list once decided.
